entities.summary: Simi Bedford is a Nigerian novelist based in Britain. Her 1991 debut book Yoruba Girl Dancing, an autobiographical novel about a young Nigerian girl who is sent to England to receive a private school education, was well reviewed on publication and was the subject of a BBC Radio 4 abridgement. Her second novel, Not With Silver, was published in 2007. Simi Bedford was a authors & novelists from Lagos (b. 1941, Lagos). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
